name: Ice Runner
body:
You maintain your balance and grip when moving across icy or snowy surfaces.

Prerequisite(s): Acrobatics 3 ranks, Climb 3 ranks.

Benefit(s): You ignore up to –5 in penalties due to slippery surfaces on Acrobatics checks and Climb checks, allowing you to move across icy terrain or climb icy surfaces with greater ease than most. When you fail an Acrobatics check while walking across ice or snow, your movement, if any, is halted, but you do not fall prone.
